title: Span-content search tests must serialize inputs the way the tracing SDK does
answers: how to test trace search with unicode text
why does my search test pass without the unicode fix
span content json.dumps escapes unicode in tests
body:
Convention: Tests for `trace.text` / `span.content` search build span inputs with `dump_span_attribute_value` from mlflow/tracing/utils.py, not with plain `json.dumps`.
Why: the `create_test_span` helper uses default `json.dumps`, which already escapes non-ASCII, so a test built on it passes even without the `ensure_ascii=False` fix and does not exercise the bug.
Placement: see tests/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store/test_sqlalchemy_store_traces.py:test_search_traces_with_full_text_filter_non_ascii, parametrized over LIKE/ILIKE and both `trace.text` and `span.content` keys.
Constraints: The test is skipped on MSSQL (`IS_MSSQL`) because MSSQL keeps the escaped form of span content.
applies: Sqlalchemy store tests that create spans with non-ASCII content and assert on search results.
says: Searching traces with non-English characters in the trace search bar returns no matching results.
Trace content search fails to find execution traces that contain special or accented Unicode text.
Support full-text search and filtering across trace spans containing international languages.
Filtering traces by message text ignores spans with non-ASCII symbols in the tracking dashboard.
Users should be able to query trace content using foreign language search terms.
search: Tests for `trace.text` and `span.content` search must serialize span inputs using `dump_span_attribute_value` from `mlflow/tracing/utils.py` instead of plain `json.dumps`. Standard `json.dumps` escapes non-ASCII characters, hiding bugs where unicode text searches fail unless `ensure_ascii=False` is tested. The convention is implemented in `tests/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store/test_sqlalchemy_store_traces.py:test_search_traces_with_full_text_filter_non_ascii`, parametrized across LIKE and ILIKE operators for both search keys. Applies specifically to SQLAlchemy store trace search tests, but is skipped on MSSQL because MSSQL retains escaped span content.
